[.walkthrough]
.Look at a field and its properties
. Click the [.walkthrough-look]#eye# in the toolbar to switch to *Inspect* mode.
+
video::{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/inspect/01-mode.mp4[options="autoplay,loop,muted",poster="{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/inspect/01-mode.jpg"]
. Point at a component to see what it is, and click to select it. Its [.walkthrough-look]#badge# has the component's documentation, its properties, and a menu.
+
video::{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/inspect/02-select.mp4[options="autoplay,loop,muted",poster="{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/inspect/02-select.jpg"]
. *Properties* shows the component's [.walkthrough-look]#properties# and their values. In Inspect mode you can look; to change them, switch to Edit mode.
+
video::{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/inspect/03-properties.mp4[options="autoplay,loop,muted",poster="{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/inspect/03-properties.jpg"]
